1 Read input data

dose_data <- read.csv(
  "full_simulation_data_three_scenarios.csv"
)

pd_parameters <- read.csv(
  "Emax and EC50.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

scenario_list <- list(
  "Raw shrimp consumption" = dose_data$D_raw,
  "Undercooked shrimp consumption" = dose_data$D_under,
  "Hand-mediated cross-contamination" = dose_data$D_hand
)

scenario_levels <- names(scenario_list)

2 SD-DRM parameters

alpha <- 0.60
beta <- 1.31e6
tfs <- 1
MIC <- 0.13

n_person_years <- 100000

consumption_mean <- 0.0369
consumption_se <- 0.0031
days_per_year <- 365

fr_fixed <- 0.20
pMIC_fixed <- 2

pMIC_seq <- seq(0, 10, by = 0.1)
pMIC_plot <- c(0, 1, 2, 5)
pMIC_breaks <- seq(0, 10, by = 1)

fr_seq <- seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.05)
fr_plot <- c(0, 0.2, 0.5)
fr_breaks <- seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.05)

3 Draw paired Emax and EC50 values

set.seed(annual_seed + 1)

pd_id <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(pd_parameters)),
  size = nrow(dose_data),
  replace = TRUE
)

Emax_mc <- pd_parameters$Emax_per_day[pd_id]
EC50_mc <- pd_parameters$EC50_ug_mL[pd_id]

Sampling the row index ensures that each \(E_{\max}\) value remains paired with the \(EC_{50}\) value obtained from the same bootstrap run.

4 Create susceptible-parameter lookup table

ab_lookup <- make_ab_lookup(
  alpha = alpha,
  beta = beta,
  Emax = pd_parameters$Emax_per_day,
  EC50 = pd_parameters$EC50_ug_mL,
  C_max = max(pMIC_seq) / 100 * MIC,
  tfs = tfs,
  seed = annual_seed + 3
)

5 Save sensitivity-analysis simulation data

The sensitivity dataset contains the original exposure inputs, variable SD-DRM inputs, paired pharmacodynamic parameters, the calculated pharmacodynamic effect, and the corresponding event-level infection risks.

set.seed(annual_seed + 2)

n_sensitivity <- nrow(dose_data)

fr_sensitivity <- runif(
  n_sensitivity,
  min(fr_seq),
  max(fr_seq)
)

pMIC_sensitivity <- sample(
  pMIC_seq,
  n_sensitivity,
  replace = TRUE
)

C_sensitivity <- pMIC_sensitivity / 100 * MIC

calc_sensitivity_risk <- function(dose) {
  calc_sd_drm(
    dose = dose,
    fr = fr_sensitivity,
    C = C_sensitivity,
    alpha = alpha,
    beta = beta,
    Emax = Emax_mc,
    EC50 = EC50_mc,
    tfs = tfs,
    ab_lookup = ab_lookup
  )
}

sensitivity_raw <- calc_sensitivity_risk(dose_data$D_raw)
sensitivity_under <- calc_sensitivity_risk(dose_data$D_under)
sensitivity_hand <- calc_sensitivity_risk(dose_data$D_hand)

sensitivity_data <- cbind(
  simulation_id = seq_len(n_sensitivity),
  dose_data,
  pd_id = pd_id,
  Bootstrap_run = pd_parameters$Bootstrap_run[pd_id],
  Emax = Emax_mc,
  EC50 = EC50_mc,
  fr = fr_sensitivity,
  pMIC = pMIC_sensitivity,
  C_doxycycline = C_sensitivity,
  PD_effect = sensitivity_raw$PD_effect,
  risk_raw = sensitivity_raw$risk_total,
  risk_undercooked = sensitivity_under$risk_total,
  risk_hand = sensitivity_hand$risk_total
)

saveRDS(
  sensitivity_data,
  file = "SD-DRM output for sensitivity analysis.rds",
  compress = FALSE
)

rm(
  C_sensitivity,
  fr_sensitivity,
  pMIC_sensitivity,
  sensitivity_raw,
  sensitivity_under,
  sensitivity_hand,
  sensitivity_data,
  calc_sensitivity_risk
)

6 Empirical parameter functions

annualise_risk <- function(p, K_j) {
  
  K_distribution <- prop.table(table(K_j))
  K_values <- as.numeric(names(K_distribution))
  K_weights <- as.numeric(K_distribution)
  
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, 0), 1)
  annual_risk <- numeric(length(p))
  
  for (i in seq_along(K_values)) {
    annual_risk <- annual_risk +
      K_weights[i] * (1 - (1 - p)^K_values[i])
  }
  
  annual_risk
}

calc_empirical_curve <- function(dose, fr, C, K_j) {
  
  n_dose <- length(dose)
  n_pd <- nrow(pd_parameters)
  
  out <- calc_sd_drm(
    dose = rep(dose, each = n_pd),
    fr = fr,
    C = C,
    alpha = alpha,
    beta = beta,
    Emax = rep(pd_parameters$Emax_per_day, times = n_dose),
    EC50 = rep(pd_parameters$EC50_ug_mL, times = n_dose),
    tfs = tfs,
    ab_lookup = ab_lookup
  )
  
  annual_risk_matrix <- matrix(
    annualise_risk(out$risk_total, K_j),
    nrow = n_pd
  )
  
  status_matrix <- matrix(
    as.character(out$status),
    nrow = n_pd
  )
  
  list(
    mean_annual_risk = colMeans(annual_risk_matrix),
    
    status = apply(
      status_matrix,
      2,
      function(x) names(which.max(table(x)))
    )
  )
}

7 Scenario exploration functions

make_annual_dose_response_data <- function(
  vary_by,
  values,
  fixed_fr = NULL,
  fixed_pMIC = NULL,
  n_person_years_curve = n_person_years,
  seed = annual_seed
) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  F_j <- rnorm(
    n_person_years_curve,
    consumption_mean,
    consumption_se
  )
  
  F_j <- pmin(pmax(F_j, 0), 1)
  
  K_j <- rbinom(
    n_person_years_curve,
    days_per_year,
    F_j
  )
  
  do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      names(scenario_list),
      function(scn) {
        
        dose_vector <- scenario_list[[scn]]
        
        positive_dose <- dose_vector[
          dose_vector > 0 & is.finite(dose_vector)
        ]
        
        dose_grid <- 10^seq(
          log10(min(positive_dose)),
          log10(max(positive_dose)),
          length.out = 300
        )
        
        do.call(
          rbind,
          lapply(
            values,
            function(v) {
              
              fr_use <- if (vary_by == "fr") v else fixed_fr
              pMIC_use <- if (vary_by == "pMIC") v else fixed_pMIC
              
              out <- calc_empirical_curve(
                dose = dose_grid,
                fr = fr_use,
                C = pMIC_use / 100 * MIC,
                K_j = K_j
              )
              
              data.frame(
                Scenario = scn,
                dose = dose_grid,
                value = v,
                
                group = if (vary_by == "pMIC") {
                  paste0(v, "% MIC")
                } else {
                  paste0("fr = ", v)
                },
                
                mean_annual_risk = out$mean_annual_risk,
                status = out$status
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
}

summarise_scenario_annual_risk <- function(
  vary_by,
  values,
  fixed_fr = NULL,
  fixed_pMIC = NULL,
  seed = annual_seed
) {
  
  do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      names(scenario_list),
      function(scn) {
        
        dose_vector <- scenario_list[[scn]]
        
        do.call(
          rbind,
          lapply(
            values,
            function(v) {
              
              fr_use <- if (vary_by == "fr") v else fixed_fr
              pMIC_use <- if (vary_by == "pMIC") v else fixed_pMIC
              
              event_risk <- calc_sd_drm(
                dose = dose_vector,
                fr = fr_use,
                C = pMIC_use / 100 * MIC,
                alpha = alpha,
                beta = beta,
                Emax = Emax_mc,
                EC50 = EC50_mc,
                tfs = tfs,
                ab_lookup = ab_lookup
              )
              
              annual_data <- simulate_annual_risk(
                daily_risk = event_risk$risk_total,
                n_person_years = n_person_years,
                consumption_mean = consumption_mean,
                consumption_se = consumption_se,
                days_per_year = days_per_year,
                seed = seed
              )
              
              annual_risk <- annual_data$annual_risk
              positive_annual_risk <- annual_risk[annual_risk > 0]
              
              conditional_quantiles <- quantile(
                positive_annual_risk,
                probs = c(
                  0.025,
                  0.125,
                  0.25,
                  0.50,
                  0.75,
                  0.875,
                  0.975
                ),
                names = FALSE
              )
              
              mean_less_risk <- mean(
                event_risk$risk_less_treatable
              )
              
              mean_more_risk <- mean(
                event_risk$risk_more_treatable
              )
              
              data.frame(
                Scenario = scn,
                value = v,
                
                probability_zero_annual_risk =
                  mean(annual_risk == 0),
                
                mean_annual_risk =
                  mean(annual_risk),
                
                p025_positive_annual_risk =
                  conditional_quantiles[1],
                
                p125_positive_annual_risk =
                  conditional_quantiles[2],
                
                p25_positive_annual_risk =
                  conditional_quantiles[3],
                
                median_positive_annual_risk =
                  conditional_quantiles[4],
                
                p75_positive_annual_risk =
                  conditional_quantiles[5],
                
                p875_positive_annual_risk =
                  conditional_quantiles[6],
                
                p975_positive_annual_risk =
                  conditional_quantiles[7],
                
                mean_consumption_days =
                  mean(annual_data$K_j),
                
                outcome = ifelse(
                  mean_less_risk >= mean_more_risk,
                  "Less likely treatable",
                  "More likely treatable"
                )
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
}

prepare_annual_summary <- function(data) {
  
  data$Scenario <- factor(
    data$Scenario,
    levels = scenario_levels
  )
  
  data$outcome <- factor(
    data$outcome,
    levels = c(
      "More likely treatable",
      "Less likely treatable"
    )
  )
  
  data[order(data$Scenario, data$value), ]
}

make_log10_annual_summary <- function(
  data,
  parameter_name
) {
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Scenario = as.character(data$Scenario),
    value = data$value,
    probability_zero_annual_risk =
      data$probability_zero_annual_risk,
    mean_consumption_days =
      data$mean_consumption_days,
    outcome = as.character(data$outcome),
    
    log10_mean_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$mean_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p025_positive_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p025_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p125_positive_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p125_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p25_positive_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p25_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_median_positive_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$median_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p75_positive_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p75_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p875_positive_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p875_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p975_positive_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p975_positive_annual_risk)
  )
  
  names(result)[names(result) == "value"] <- parameter_name
  result
}

make_conditional_median_plot_data <- function(
  data,
  parameter_name
) {
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Scenario = as.character(data$Scenario),
    value = data$value,
    outcome = as.character(data$outcome),
    
    log10_median_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$median_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p025_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p025_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p125_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p125_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p25_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p25_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p75_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p75_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p875_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p875_positive_annual_risk),
    
    log10_p975_annual_risk =
      safe_log10(data$p975_positive_annual_risk)
  )
  
  names(result)[names(result) == "value"] <- parameter_name
  result
}

save_annual_outputs <- function(
  data,
  parameter_name,
  summary_file,
  plot_data_file
) {
  
  write.csv(
    make_log10_annual_summary(
      data,
      parameter_name
    ),
    file.path("results", summary_file),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  write.csv(
    make_conditional_median_plot_data(
      data,
      parameter_name
    ),
    file.path("results", plot_data_file),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

make_selected_annual_summary <- function(
  data,
  selected_value,
  scenario_exploration,
  selected_condition
) {
  
  x <- subset(data, value == selected_value)
  
  data.frame(
    Scenario_exploration = scenario_exploration,
    Selected_condition = selected_condition,
    Exposure_scenario = as.character(x$Scenario),
    
    Probability_zero_annual_risk =
      round(x$probability_zero_annual_risk, 4),
    
    Mean_consumption_days =
      round(x$mean_consumption_days, 2),
    
    log10_mean_annual_risk =
      round(safe_log10(x$mean_annual_risk), 3),
    
    Dominant_outcome =
      as.character(x$outcome)
  )
}
